raw_text:
PLAN "Postpartum On-Ramp Block (10-14 Weeks Postpartum)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Rebuild baseline strength and core and pelvic floor control"
  GOAL secondary endurance:
    name "Restore aerobic base with low-impact work"

PHASES
  PHASE "On-Ramp" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Acclimatisation A - Foundations":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 2x6 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds
          cat_cow 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Acclimatisation B - Upper and Posture":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          scapular_retraction 2x12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          push_up 2x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 2x6 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          external_rotation 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 45 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 45 seconds
          child_pose 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 25m "Acclimatisation C - Walk and Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 2x15 seconds rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 10 minutes
          hip_flexor_stretch 45 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Lower and Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x6..8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 2x20 seconds rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 45 seconds
          child_pose 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Upper and Posture":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x6..8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 45 seconds
          tricep_stretch 45 seconds
      DAY Friday training 30m "Low-Impact Conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main circuit:
          step_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          marching 3x30 seconds rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
          calf_stretch 45 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 45 seconds
          pigeon_pose 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Upper Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          rear_delt_fly 2x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 45 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 45 seconds
      DAY Friday training 35m "Aerobic and Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 15 minutes rpe 5
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          side_plank 3x20 seconds rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
          child_pose 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Strength and Core":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 45 seconds
          figure_four_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Strength":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 45 seconds
          tricep_stretch 45 seconds
      DAY Friday training 40m "Aerobic Base and Full Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 20 minutes rpe 5
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5 minutes
          child_pose 60 seconds

goals.name: Rebuild baseline strength and core and pelvic floor control
Restore aerobic base with low-impact work
